Class MtpAnchorPool

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.model.qwen.MtpAnchorPool
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class MtpAnchorPool extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Per-request MTP draft anchor (post-final-norm hidden feeding the MTP head's first draft step), keyed by request id.

QwenModel.lastPreNormHidden is a single field shared by every forward (decode/prefill/verify), for whichever batch of requests that forward just processed — safe only because at most one request was ever mid-speculative-round at a time. Real multi-request batching needs each request's anchor kept durably in its own row, scattered here immediately after the forward that produced it (see Qwen.scatterMtpAnchor), so a later forward for a different batch can never clobber it.

    • setRow

      public void setRow(int requestId, Tensor row)
      Writes row's content into requestId's durable anchor. Allocates the pool's backing tensor on the first call ever made on this pool (dtype/device taken from row); the anchor dimension itself is a fixed model hyperparameter, so no later reallocation is expected.
      Parameters:
      requestId - bound request id.
      row - anchor row [D] or [1, D].
